actual_behavior: Ordinary eligible server tick: Entity.baseTick first copies/clears powder-snow state; LivingEntity.baseTick then ticks effects; Frosted sets the flag and adds amp when amp>0/canFreeze; later LivingEntity.aiStep travel precedes native freezing (+1). With stable amp a>=0, no intervening fire/reset and canFreeze, F_next=min(140,F+a+1). Otherwise native aiStep decays by2 when not powder-snow eligible. No unconditional stun or fixed HP drain.

At base Entity fire processing, remaining fire can request on_fire every20ticks and clears existing frozen ticks before effect tick. Later Entity.move can extinguish remaining fire using the Frosted powder-snow flag; its ordinary collision path is required (noPhysics/early movement branches differ). LivingEntity.baseTick extinguish check precedes Frosted application, not follows it.

Movement contribution is -0.15*(a+1) ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL with distinct modifier id; native frozen-ground penalty is additionally -0.05*min(F,140)/140 ADD_VALUE when standing over nonair. Native attribute order and clamping apply. These are movement penalties, not AI disabling.

After gauge update and frost attribute refresh, every entity tickCount%40==0 with fully frozen/canFreeze requests ownerless minecraft:freeze amount1. Twilight incoming hook for exact minecraft:freeze replaces newDamage with originalDamage+integer(a/2). Normal nonnegative a therefore yields requested1+floor(a/2), before shield/freezing-extra/helmet/iframes/armor/magic/absorption pipeline. Expiration earlier in this tick removes the bonus while the last set powder-snow flag can still produce native gauge+1.

Raw vanilla freeze tag closure: bypasses_armor, bypasses_shield, bypasses_wolf_armor, is_freezing, no_knockback, panic_causes and panic_environmental_causes. Thus native freeze bypasses ordinary armor/shield/Wolf armor, applies extra-types*5, retains Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown, and has no native hurt knockback. Player freezeDamage=false rejects damage before incoming callback but does not itself disable the frozen gauge.

For IS_FIRE incoming damage, remove Frosted, decrement the same instance amplifier, re-add if nonnegative; hidden chain and remaining duration are retained when removal succeeds. No final HP-damage gate. Fire Resistance, dead/client/invulnerable and player fireDamage/creative rejection occur before incoming event, so they prevent this hook. Shield/cooldown/armor mitigation occurs after it, so an admitted incoming event can downrank even when subsequent damage is rejected.

Fresh effect amplifier clamps0..255. Normal addEffect uses loader applicability and Added events; stronger may hide old weaker state, equal amp extends longer duration, weaker longer duration can be hidden. There is no additive amp stacking. Every tick applies before duration decrement; hidden durations also decrement and may be restored. Removal/expiration are event-vetoable; server attribute removal/refresh follows successful native lifecycle.

Default NeoForge cures for fresh Frosted are milk and protected_by_totem; honey is only added for Poison and does not cure Frosted. Removal does not directly zero frozenTicks; ordinary decay follows unless some other flag/gauge producer remains. Fire remove/readd ignores removal return: an external removal veto can leave the same live instance mutated and normal attribute refresh need not occur; this is retained native hook behavior, not a proposed fix.

Helper excludes freeze-immune entity types, any freeze-immune wearable in HEAD/CHEST/LEGS/FEET, and creative Players. Native LivingEntity.canFreeze additionally excludes spectators and BODY freeze-immune wearables. Those extra exclusions block buildup/periodic freeze, not necessarily the status movement modifier. Environment enforcement uses direct addEffect and deliberately does not repeat helper equipment checks.

actual_behavior: Native boss spawner attempts6 Knights in60-degree radius4 ring; generic range9 plus nearestPlayerY>spawnerY-2 and nonPeaceful. Finalize, assign same GlobalPos home, setNumber(i), add entity; spawned increments only on add success, spawner remains until6 successes. spawned is not custom NBT-saved; partial failure/reload is not a transactional unique six-member group. Hard gives OFFHAND knightmetal_shield only to i=5, before initialization/numbering. getNearbyKnights is class query in own BB.inflate64 with LivingEntity.isAlive and includes self; no group UUID, team, owner, shared home requirement, or six-member cap. Multiple encounters within range can mix; membership is local and geometry-dependent. Each has independent HP35, formation/counter/charge position. Lowest current number in observed list leads normal formation selection; ties can each qualify, no unique shared lock. updateMyNumber copies another number0 home, fills smaller/duplicate indices, tracks maximum known count for bossbar only. Death postmortem renumbers survivors only when BaseTFBoss.shouldSpawnLoot (doMobLoot) permits postmortem; later switchToFormation also renumbers. Group bossbar aggregate/totalKnownKnights is presentation, not a shared HP resource, reserve, heal or damage redistribution.

Initial HOVER90. Formation durations in GOAL update counts: LARGE clockwise/anticlockwise180, SMALL90, four axis traversals180, WAITING10, ATTACK_PLAYER_START50, ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK50. Default requiresUpdateEveryTick=false so native selector normally ticks these on alternating game ticks; all-time counters are not seconds. Update goal always active, no flags: sets noPhysics from OLD progress%20!=0, increments, transitions if>=duration, then sends wanted destination speed2 if FLAG_CHARGING else1. Lowest-number leader when ordinary formation ends randomly chooses smallCW2/8,smallCCW2/8, each axis1/8, broadcasts to all observed noncharging Knights including self, then if none charging chooses RANDOM nearby Knight for ATTACK_PLAYER_START. It is not rotating turn order. Large-circle enum destinations are implemented but not selected by this native random chooser; no fabricated large-circle producer is claimed. START -> ATTACK; ATTACK with>1 live near ->WAITING; WAITING after10 copies nearbyKnights[1] formation/progress (query order, not a proven leader lookup), else START. Broadcast does not reset an already charging member. Local lists/goal order, simultaneous transitions and reload mean no globally guaranteed exclusive attacker.

With nearby list size1 at ATTACK end, code first randomly creates sword/axe/pick, THEN switchToFormation(ATTACK_PLAYER_START) calls updateMyNumber. Since there are no OTHER living Knights, nums.isEmpty => setNumber(0), which immediately replaces chosen weapon with sword. Final native survivor therefore reenters sword role; do NOT claim lasting random weapon cycling. A freshly solitary Knight also leaves totalKnownKnights=Integer.MIN_VALUE in that empty-neighbor branch, causing customServerAiStep to retry updateMyNumber each time and reset sword; this field is not an ammunition/shared-health resource. Losses can change surviving weapon roles through renumbering. No regeneration or HP transfer after deaths.

Knight overrides knockback: ignores supplied strength and native KR/hook method, sets impulse, halves current XYZ motion, adds fixed horizontal -ratio/sqrt(xRatio^2+zRatio^2)*.2 and Y+.2, caps Y at.4. There is NO zero-direction guard, so (0,0) produces undefined/NaN horizontal arithmetic; no runtime consequence fabricated. Ordinary native collision push still depends on noPhysics separately. At HP0 native dead damage rejection remains. Base death tick increments; Knight removal requires deathTime>=88 AND no nearby living Knights. At>=18 size set0; corpse can wait while others live, not share their HP. hasYetToDisappear controls initial rise .015 and rendering; last permitted postmortem resets nearby dead Knights deathTime1 and syncs packet, then IT_IS_OVER=true. No resurrection. MobLoot=false skips that reset/renumber postmortem; eventual88/no-live removal still governs. Peaceful spawner/discard and ordinary BaseTFBoss restrictions remain. actual_behavior: Hydra is BaseTFBoss, base HP360/movement0.28, registered root dimensions16x12 and fireproof. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE remains pinned. Seven containers each hold one 4x4 HydraHead and five 2x2 HydraNecks; body6x6, two legs2x3 and tail6x2 give46 Entity parts. They are TFPart/NeoForge PartEntity, NOT LivingEntity, with no independent HP. First three containers start IDLE, remaining four DEAD. Root is not pickable; actual parts are pickable and forward the same DamageSource to the parent. NeoForge part IDs/world queries/native Player reach and impact hooks are reused. HydraPart.hurt does not itself reject inactive dimensions or markedDead: parent state admission is decisive. Only head hits add that head counter; neck/body/leg/tail hits affect parent HP without adding a head counter. Multiple queried parts or piercing-arrow part IDs can cause multiple attempts, but all forward to ONE parent cooldown/HP pipeline. A rejected arrow hit can still increase a head counter; nonpiercing arrow callback/discard follows the returned bool, not the counter. No seven independent HP pools or guaranteed multiplied HP damage. Positioning caveat from complete Hydra methods: aiStep explicitly ticks body and both legs (not tail), repositions body and tail (not legs), and container tick repositions head/necks. No dedicated leg reposition call exists; do not assume all46 parts form correctly placed independent body hitboxes. No runtime positioning result or fix is claimed.

Exact part admission order: server IN_WALL first attempts terrain clearing; then reject causing OR direct entity equal to Hydra; reject either equal to any own part; identify the exact head or reject a neck belonging to DYING/DEAD head; compute parent-to-causing-entity distanceSquared (-1 if absent); reject >400, or >600 when DIRECT entity is HydraMortar; reject DYING/DEAD head; forward to BaseTFBoss.hurt. Head interpolated mouth openness strictly>0.5 forwards original amount; every other part/closed head forwards Math.round(amount/8F). Closed-head/body armor is this fixed pre-pipeline reduction, not armor attribute or a bypassable armor tag. Open-head counter adds (int)original amount; closed-head counter adds rounded amount, AFTER hurt regardless of its bool or actual HP. Admission rejects before forwarding add nothing. Native server/alive/fire-resistance/events/shield/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection/absorption then decide HP. True alone resets ticksSinceDamaged. Parent hurt called directly accepts only BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY; part forwarding deliberately calls super.hurt and avoids that root gate. Hydra.isInvulnerableTo returns false for exact hydra_mortar, otherwise superclass (fireproof included); this exception does not remove later Living fire-resistance, dead/client/event/cooldown checks and does not bypass the root hurt gate. Own unreflected mortar is rejected by owner identity even with the correct type. Source owner range, not projectile range/home radius, governs distant attacks; ownerless source skips range. BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY does not override the preceding part self/range/state gates.

actual_behavior: Each head has integer damageTaken, initially0; addDamage truncates each float request independently, never reads actual HP loss. Server AI schedules DYING only when !isDead and damageTaken>120 (strictly greater, not >=120), ends current action and sets respawnCounter140. It also picks one random current DEAD head whose counter==-1 and schedules140 if any; there is no eighth head. DYING counts as dead for attacks/hurt and active-count, but isActive means state!=DEAD, so DYING is saved as active. DYING lasts70; respawn countdown only decrements while current DEAD. A newly recruited already-DEAD head therefore starts its140 countdown immediately, while the killed head waits through DYING first. At --counter<=0, schedule BORN, reset damageTaken0, end current action and set counter-1. Then BORN20 -> ROAR_START10 -> ROAR_RAWR50 -> IDLE. No parent heal in head regrowth and no fire/cauterize predicate. All seven can ultimately be active. Bite remains restricted to head indexes0..2 and requires active-count>2; all heads can flame/mortar. Loss can reduce concurrency and suppress bites until regrowth; it is not an HP-threshold phase.

Container server tick: tick head/necks; update difficulty; activate nondead zero-width parts or deactivate DEAD parts; advance respawn, then ++ticksProgress and transition when>=ticksNeeded, then position/facing/execute/sounds. A transition sets progress0, so attack runs on entry. Explicit pending next state wins automatic successor; endCurrentAction sets progress=ticksNeeded for next tick. Initial active IDLE uses60/60 (transitions next tick); enum IDLE duration10 thereafter. Durations: BITE_BEGINNING40 -> BITE_READY80 -> BITING7 -> BITE_ENDING40 -> ATTACK_COOLDOWN80 -> IDLE; FLAME_BEGINNING40 -> FLAMING100 -> FLAME_ENDING30 -> cooldown; MORTAR_BEGINNING40 -> MORTAR_SHOOTING25 -> MORTAR_ENDING30 -> cooldown; DYING70 -> DEAD20 loop; birth sequence as above. Secondary attacks replace automatic cooldown with IDLE and clear their flag. Mouth is clamped interpolation previous-state to current-state, not a binary attack flag: idle/cooldown/dead/born/ending0, flame/mortar beginning0.75 and active1, bite beginning0.25/ready1/biting0.2, roar-start0.25/roar1. Thus vulnerable >0.5 includes portions of windup/end/roar, not all attack ticks; for example BITING starts open and closes during seven ticks. Death marks head at1 and five necks at10/20/30/40/50, then each marked part deactivates at its deathTime20. Size/state/mouth/current+last and names are synced through existing multipart data; not independent health.

ticksSinceDamaged increments in aiStep; custom server AI heal(1) only when counter>1000 and divisible5: first1005, then every5 until forwarded hurt true resets0. Native heal event may alter/cancel; setHealth clamps max; no DamageSource and no head-counter reset from healing. Root bypass damage does not use that reset branch. NBT stores NumHeads BITMASK (not numeric count), HeadNames, native HP/home; only set bits queue IDLE/end action on load, with NO clearing of constructor first-three defaults. Thus dead first-three heads are reactivated on reload even with clear saved bits; DYING saved bits also return idle. Per-head damage, pending action/progress/respawn counter, target, regen counter and secondary flag are unsaved. Death tick1 cancels all respawn and interrupts nondead heads to IDLE/hurtTime200; ticks20..140 schedule indexes0..6 DYING when nondead; exactly200 remove KILLED, without ordinary Base tickDeath. Peaceful discards head entities then Base restores valid loaded home spawner/discards root. Head death particles, roars, name clearing and bossbar are not new damage.

Damage request48, twilightforest:hydra_bite, direct=causing=Hydra, not head; entity-type exclusion argument only affects death text. Physical source retains armor/Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown; preemptive stop-use normally prevents ordinary shield block for that attempt. actual_behavior: FLAMING runs one server look-target query per tick for100 state ticks, not one hit per rendered flame. Track target coordinates toward entity by normalized step0.04 (Hard0.1); facing max5 degrees yaw. Ray source=(headX,headY+1,headZ), view vector, endpoint30. Block.OUTLINE/Fluid.ANY clip supplies a BlockPos even for MISS; candidate AABB is headBB MOVED by look*(per-axis min(30,abs(head-coordinate-hitBlock-coordinate))) and inflated3, NOT a swept30-long box. Normal armor/shield/Resistance/protection/absorption/shared cooldown and fire immunity/Fire Resistance apply. Fire tag is not projectile or explosion. Later burning is native on_fire, a separate source, not repeated hydra_fire; no terrain ignition here.

actual_behavior: MORTAR_SHOOTING progress0/10/20 creates three HydraMortars per state sequence. Owner=parent Hydra via ThrowableProjectile(owner). Position=head look*3.5 plus headY+1; head velocity is zeroed; shootFromRotation(head,pitch,yaw,-20,0.5,1) supplies upward pitch offset and inaccuracy. If current target nonnull and head COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE LOS fails, set megaBlast true (no target => ordinary). Gravity0.05, native throwable movement/collision/impact hook/deflection; type0.75x0.75 fireproof, pickable radius1.5. onHit override dispatches its own entity/block callback and omits superclass Projectile.onHit redirection of a struck projectile. Entity hit server requires owner nonnull; if target another mortar, requires target.getOwner().is(owner), not different owner (ownerless target dereference has no null guard); reject target.is(owner) or own HydraPart while owner Hydra. Allowed entity hit detonates; disallowed hit has no discard. Ordinary block top hit sets vertical speed0 and onGround=true; other faces detonate then still set onGround. Mega detonates on any block. Ground tick calls immutable velocity.multiply(.9) but discards its result: no extra .9 damping is applied. Server fuse starts80 and postdecrements only onGround, detonating when old<=0 (81 grounded checks). No airborne lifetime fuse.

detonate FIRST calls native Level.explode(source=mortar,radius ordinary0.1 or mega4,fire=canEntityGrief(level,mortar),interaction=MOB); THEN loops entities in mortarBB.inflate(1) without owner exclusion or LOS. Non-fire-immune entities OR any Hydra/HydraPart receive18 twilightforest:hydra_mortar direct=mortar, causing=current owner (nullable); only true ignites5 seconds. Finally discard regardless accepted HP damage. There is no separate on-collision18 hit before explosion:18 is the post-explosion nearby query, and ignores explosion exposure. Native explosion source is minecraft:player_explosion when direct mortar and Living indirect owner both exist (despite the type name, original Hydra owner qualifies), otherwise minecraft:explosion. Standard radius/exposure damage formula and separate knockback apply. The18 request is fire-tagged, NOT IS_EXPLOSION or IS_PROJECTILE and NOT armor bypass; Explosion Protection applies to preceding explosion, Fire Protection to the custom18, ordinary Protection/Resistance/absorption/cooldown remain. Explosion may consume cooldown before18, so never sum full damage automatically. Mega block resistance min(original,0.8) except COMMON_PROTECTIONS; native explosion block/event/mobGriefing rules still apply. Ordinary radius0.1 can damage very-near entities; it is not an inert cosmetic explosion. A reflected mortar splash can attempt multiple Hydra parts and counters; closed parts round18/8 to2, open heads forward18, owner-distance<=sqrt600 and shared parent cooldown still apply.

Entity tag REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE includes HydraMortar. Native Player.attack after attack-interaction admission invokes AIM_DEFLECT and RETURNS before target.hurt; direction becomes player look normalized (speed1), owner=Player. This normal reflection does NOT clear onGround, extend fuse, use speed1.5 or toggle mega. An incoming projectile using superclass Projectile.onHit can first redirect a tagged mortar to its owner. Separately, a genuine source reaching HydraMortar.hurt calls super.hurt but ignores that return: on server any nonnull causing entity shoots along its look at1.5/inaccuracy0.1, clears onGround, adds20 fuse; only Living causing entity replaces owner; returns true regardless amount. Ownerless/client returns false. Native incoming arrow may therefore run both redirection and hurt callbacks; callers that override onHit may omit the first. Mortar is NOT ITFProjectile; pinned parryNonTwilightAttacks=false means TF timed shield parry does not catch it, despite its Twilight registry name. No custom save methods: inherited projectile saves owner/leftOwner/shot plus Entity position/motion/onGround, but fuse and mega reset80/false on reload. Ordinary Player reflection after reload remains tag-based. Preserve these distinct native paths; do not fabricate a reflected DamageSource.

Both are nonfireproof: inherited accepted lava4 first ignite5 and, if hurt true, removes exact lava in inflated9 box, separate from grief-gated clearing. No new implementation/fix or runtime outcome. Freeze/fall/entity boss tags, source tags and DamageType scaling are distinct namespaces/mechanics.

effects.primary_test_source: Native goblin swinging part contact
alternate_sources: Native throw/retract, blockedhit/partwall, multi-target query, PrimedTNTavoid
actual_behavior: After super.tick andparttick, positive recoil--, angle+=16 mod360. isSwingingChain = swinging OR(targetnonnull &&recoil==0). Orbit radius.9 while swinging, else.3; Yoffset1.5-radius/4. Whenextension>0 partposition=currentviewXZ*extension plus goblinXYZ, Y=eyeHeight+.25 (viewYnotused); extension>=6 turns throwingfalse before collision. Server alive&&(throwing ORswinging) queries partBBinflate(.2,0,.2); every pushable entity exceptgoblin is pushed bycollider BEFORE damage. Livingcollided then calls SUPER.doHurtTarget, so ordinary minecraft:mob_attack effective8 direct=causingGoblin, NOT the SPIKED override. LivingnonPlayercauser scales Player Peaceful0/Easymin(a/2+1,a)/Normal a/Hard1.5a. True adds independentY+.4, sound/PROJECTILE_LAND, recoil40 and clears throwing; false retains priorpush but no extraY/recoil/stop. Loop can affect multiple candidates even after one success changesflags. No explicit LOS/team filter here, standard superclass damage checks remain. Whilethrowing, collider.isInWall stops throw/sounds/HIT_GROUND without breakingblock. Endoftick extension +=.5 ifthrowing else-=1.5, clamped0..6. No source on orbit movement alone; damage requires collision selection. Returning part may still collide when swingpredicate true; recoil suppresses target-driven swing but explicit swinging bypasses it.

ThrowSpikeBlockGoal MOVE/LOOK, targetnonnull/distSquared<=42/cooldown<=0 then requires goblinalive/currentLOS/randomInt56==0. Else branch decrements cooldown; a qualified candidate failingrandom doesnot decrement, and counter can becomenegative. start throwingtrue, cooldown100+rand100,PROJECTILE_SHOOT; continuation extension>0 only. No customtick/aim/stopoverride, no targetalive/creative eligibility in this goal beyond inherited targetselection, no guaranteed cancellation reset when goalinterrupted. Native goalcadence rather than cooldown in seconds. PrimedTNTavoid selects first alive/LOS/notallied/noncreative/nonspectator PrimedTnt in rootBBinflate2,3,2, calls DefaultRandomPos.getPosAway(mob,16,7,mob.position()) using SELF position, rejects result closer to threat, navigates ifpath. Continues untilnavigationdone; defaultgoal cadence. Speed2 within distanceSquared<49 otherwise1. Avoidance higherpriority can interrupt MOVE; not explosionimmunity or defusal.

BlockChainGoblin HP20/speed.28/attack8/armor11, root.9x1.4, one permanent SpikeBlock part. Float0/AvoidPrimedTnt1(range2,far1/near2)/ThrowSpike4/Melee5/strolllook; retaliation/visiblePlayer. No custom hurt/death/regen/HPphase. No custom save methods for angle, recoil, extension, throwingflag or goalcooldown; nativeHP/attributes persist, these control values reset. SpikeBlock .75x.75 via setSize/refreshDimensions, TFPart/PartEntity parent relation, not an independently spawned projectile. It is unpickable/unpushable and hurt alwaysfalse, no forwarding to rootHP; is(entity) aliases self OR parent for identity only. Cannotride; own spawnpacket throws UnsupportedOperationException and saves no customdata. Parent ticks part; after parentdead part falls withY-.04, one initialgroundsound/event, no hurt call onfall. Deadparent disables attackcollision. TF multipart IDs/network handling already reviewed; source identity remains actualpart.

effects.primary_test_source: Native Player BlockAndChain use fromeitherhand
alternate_sources: Multiple distinctstacks, outsideborder, release, bounce/range/stuck/ownerloss, reload
actual_behavior: BLOCK_AND_CHAIN is ChainBlockItem extends Item, durability99, no configured attackattribute or custom melee callback. Rightclick requires stack THROWN_PROJECTILE absent and PLAYER blockPos insideworldborder. Playssound; server constructs native ChainBlock(type,level,player,hand,stack), addFreshEntity returnignored, storesUUID; bothsides startUsingItem andSUCCESS, otherwisePASS. Instant release-independent launch speed1.5/inaccuracy1/pitchoffset0, ownerPlayer, same stack object reference, hand captured, foilcosmetic. No charge scaling, launchdurabilitycost, custom usecooldown or second entity while samecomponentpresent. Use duration72000/animationBLOCK; exact NeoForge isBlocking requires SHIELD_BLOCK ability, which ChainBlockItem/Item doesnotprovide (IItemExtension defaultfalse), so holding this animation is not a native shield in installedloader. Ordinary held-item melee remains default Player attack/enchantment pipeline, not projectile10 or spiked. UUIDcomponent is persistent+network-synced; server inventoryTick removes if samecurrent ServerLevel UUID lookup is missing/notChainBlock, including unloaded/otherdimension. Not a global one-perPlayer cap; separate stacks mayeachlaunch. Block-and-chain-use release doesnot independently triggerreturn. Native inventory/equipment transitions/durability rules unchanged.

shoot overrides store velXYZ immediately aftersuper.shoot; subsequent shootFromRotation shooter-momentum addition occursaftercapture, so stored return/bounce velocity is initialshot component, not currentflightvelocity. Each tick calls super first (nativegravity/drag/collision/impacthook); server nullowner=>discard. Otherwise only whileoutbound: ifxOld!=X ORzOld!=Z, then bothabsXZdelta<.003 incrementstuckTime. ExactstationaryXZ doesnotincrement; counterneverresets onfastermotion. >=100 setsreturning. Distanceowner>16 setsreturning. Returning dist<2: ifstoredstack andLivingowner and OWNER SMASH_BLOCKS count>0 requestmin(count,3) durability, then discard; codecontinues calculatingreturnvelocity thattick. CastownerLiving is safe for legitimatePlayer launch/nativeLiving parry, not a genericanyEntityowner contract. Blend age=min(tickCount*.03,1), directiontoownereyes normalized; velocity stored*(1-age)+direction*2*age, Y also-minusgetGravity. Successfulhit+60 normallyforcesfullreturnblend. Bounce alwayssetsreturning, scales allstoredcomponents*.6 and hitface opposedcomponent anadditional*-.6; only firstoutbound/nohit playscollisionsound. No damage/durabilityfrombounceitself. Nativeimpact cancellation can skip payload; no custom TTL/lifetime guarantee. No directreturn-on-playerrelease/death/stackdrop method. remove calls super then stopsownerusing ANY BlockAndChain item ifcurrentuseisthatitem; doesnotclearUUIDitself (inventoryTick later).

NBT calls parent preservingOwner/leftOwner/hasBeenShot and native entitymotion; saves BlockAndChainStack serialized plusIsReturning, reads ItemStack.parseOptional into a NEW detached stack, not rebound to inventory. Thus laterdamagecost acts on deserializedprojectilestack; originalinventory durability sharing is only initialconstructorreference. HAND,foil,hitEntity,stuckTime,velXYZ andtickCount notsaved; defaultsMAIN/false/0 onload, evenforoffhandlaunch. Spawnpacket sendsownerID+hand andacceptsonlyLivingowner. Normalnativeproducer alwaysprovidesnonnullstack; ownerless/missingstack manufacturedentities are not legitimate testdelivery (save dereferencesstack andsuccessfulLivingowner hitdoesalso). No marker means TF shield-parry hook is ineligible with pinned parryNonTwilightAttacks=false even though Twilightregistered. No TF REDIRECTABLE_PROJECTILE contribution forChainBlock, so no ordinary melee reflection fromitsnativeentitytag. If configuration explicitly enables general parry andexternalparrymodnotloaded, protected timednativehook mayAIM_DEFLECT/currentownertransfer andcancelimpact; this is conditional setup, not currentpackdefault. IMPACT_PROJECTILES tag is not projectile DamageType tag or reflection authority. No invented reflection source.

effects.display_name: Hedge and swarm spider native AI/defense inheritance
effects.primary_test_source: Native HedgeSpider acquisition/melee in bright and dark conditions
alternate_sources: Swarm descendants sharing replacement goals; native finalized effects/riders; web/Poison/Armadillo controls
actual_behavior: All four TF Spider descendants retain native Float, Armadillo avoidance (range6, speeds1/1.2, only not-scared Armadillo), leap .4, retaliation and IronGolem targeting. Spider uses WallClimberNavigation and sets a climbing flag from horizontalCollision; exact cobweb makeStuckInBlock skips the ordinary slowdown. Exact Poison is rejected before superclass canBeAffected, including in the installed244 authority (Spider class has no244 replacement). No outgoing poison payload is added. Ordinary native effects, equipment, mitigation and health persistence remain. TF adds Hedge/King/Swarm/Broodling, HelmetCrab and Borer to minecraft:arthropod, affecting tag-based native Bane of Arthropods rather than granting Poison immunity to non-Spider classes. MosquitoSwarm is not in this scoped TF arthropod contribution. No new shield, boss phase or death attack in these bodies.

Spider.finalizeSpawn calls super then rolls nextInt(100)==0 for a vanilla Skeleton, directly finalizes it with the caller spawn reason and starts it riding the spider. Passenger creation has no explicit addFreshEntity here; ordinary native passenger-tree insertion is required. With null group data create SpiderEffectsGroupData; on Hard, randomFloat < .1*localDifficulty.specialMultiplier selects one infinite amplifier0 effect: nextInt(5) 0/1 Speed,2 Strength,3 Regeneration,4 Invisibility. Existing group data can share the selected effect. Ordinary native MobEffect attribute/heal/visibility behavior and save/load apply, not a custom resource or fixed unmodified melee amount. TF subclass finalize runs after this native setup; source fixtures must retain genuine finalization and passenger state.

HedgeSpider uses native Spider HP16/speed.3/baseattack2. Its registerGoals removes all MeleeAttackGoal instances and installs ordinary MeleeAttackGoal(priority4,speed1,longMemorytrue); replaces only priority2 NearestAttackableTargetGoal with ordinary visible Player targeting. Thus removes SpiderAttackGoal vehicle-start veto and brightness-based random continuation stop, and removes Player darkness targeting gate. Inherited IronGolem targeting still needs brightness<.5; retaliation/Armadillo avoidance/native target eligibility remain. onClimbable remains inherited. Spawn placement uses HedgeSpider.canSpawn: nonPeaceful and either current chunk landmark HEDGE_MAZE or ordinary dark-enough test; this method itself lacks SwarmSpider extra checkMobSpawnRules. Native spawn engine/placement/event checks remain; no assertion of universal aggression or unconditional spawning.

Installed Twilight4.8.3345 with raw Minecraft1.21.1 and exact NeoForge21.1.244. These melee paths use native minecraft:mob_attack, direct=causing actual attacking mob, effective ATTACK_DAMAGE plus ordinary native enchantment processing; no custom DamageSource or armor/shield/Resistance/protection/cooldown bypass. Native causingLiving difficulty scaling applies to Player victims. Native hurt true is admission, not a measured HP loss. Hunger is a vanilla MobEffect/resource operation, not another damage event; any later starvation is separate ownerless minecraft:starve, not attributed to the mosquito. Static source evidence only; no runtime, L2, SHP, Stage or production claim.

Tower inherits this exact gate. getReinforcementType returns their own EntityTypes, but an all-TF-class instruction scan proves zero call sites for that method: no native reinforcement producer is established by the method name or spawn cluster6. actual_behavior: MosquitoSwarm Monster HP12/speed.23/attack3/stepheight2.1, registered.7x1.9. Ground navigation with Float0/Melee3 speed1 longMemoryfalse/stroll6, retaliation and visible Player targeting; no flying navigation inferred from appearance. doHurtTarget first calls super; only true and LivingEntity applies vanilla Hunger amplifier0: Easy140ticks, Hard600, default300 (including code default Peaceful, whose ordinary Player hurt admission normally prevents it). addEffect has no explicit attacker and retains native eligibility, merging, removals and ticking. effects.display_name: Kobold dropped-bread pickup and temporary pacification
effects.primary_test_source: Native Kobold picks up legitimately dropped bread
alternate_sources: Grief/pickup-delay/panic failures; retaliation while bread held; timed consumption and save/load
actual_behavior: Kobold HP13/speed.28/attack4, registered.8x1.1, ordinary mob melee4 and leap.3. setCanPickUpLoot(true), native powder-snow-walkable tag; no custom armor/shield or damage source. Goals: Float0, panic1, seek bread2 and run-away-with-bread2, leap3, melee4, flock5, stroll6/look7; retaliation1 and custom Player target2. Native TF kobold_pacification_breads contains minecraft:bread directly, not the broader c:foods/bread tag. Standard bread has FOOD nutrition5/saturationModifier.6 and no effect; Kobold is not a Player and gets no native food bar or automatic HP heal from bread.

SeekBreadGoal MOVE: reject while getUseItem nonempty or panicked; nextInt(10)==0 then any tagged ItemEntity in own BBinflate8 and mainhand empty. It navigates to first result at1.2 (not nearest), start and tick; no direct pickup in this goal. Ordinary server Mob.aiStep performs actual pickup only canPickUpLoot/alive/!dead/canEntityGrief, native pickup-reach box, item not removed/nonempty/no pickup delay, wantsToPickUp -> overridden canHoldItem (mainhand empty, tagged bread, !panicked). Kobold.pickUpItem splits excess count into a new dropped ItemEntity, equips exactly1 bread, sets mainhand dropChance2, discards original item, initializes lastEatenBreadTicks1/eatingTime and clears target. It does not call native equipItemIfPossible or setPersistenceRequired here. canTakeItem only permits empty destination MAINHAND plus parent admission. No special interact/feed/tame hook, owner or allegiance change. Native dropped bread, rather than a fabricated held item, is the legitimate pacification control.

Holding a tagged mainhand stack blocks KoboldAttackPlayerTarget.canUse only; inherited continuation and HurtByTargetGoal retaliation are not overridden. Pickup explicitly clears current target once, not a universal permanent inability to attack. RunAwayWhileHoldingBreadGoal extends native AvoidEntityGoal<Player>(radius8,speed1.5/1.5), with canUse gated by held bread; inherited continuation does not repeat that held-item gate. Flock entry is also blocked by bread. On server alive+heldbread, lastEaten counter increments and positive eatingTime decrements, even while panicked; actual canEat requires FOOD component and !panicked. Initial eatingTime Easy400..999, Normal/default200..799, Hard100..699 (base+nextInt600), with decrement possible in the same aiStep as pickup. At<=0, directly calls stack.finishUsingItem; nonempty result replaces mainhand, ordinary bread mutates held stack to empty. It does not use the LivingEntity completeUsingItem/start/finish-event sequence. Native Item->Living.eat applies any actual food effects and consumes1, without Player food resources or guaranteed HP heal. lastEaten>60 plus10% roll resets only munch sound/gameevent/particles; it is not the consumption timer. Both counters save under EatingTimeLeft/TimeSinceBreadLastEaten; PANICKED is synced but not saved. Ordinary native held-item save/load retains bread; counter expiration during panic waits to consume until not panicked.

effects.display_name: Troll rock acquisition, combat task and saved state
effects.primary_test_source: Native Troll acquiring stone and throwing it
alternate_sources: Failed sample/no target; carried projectile loss; ordinary reload without RockState; death ripening exclusion
actual_behavior: Troll HP30/speed.25/attack7, registered1.4x2.4, ordinary mob_attack7 when melee goal active. Float1, RestrictSun2/FleeSun3, combat4, stroll/look; retaliation ignores Troll class for that goal, visible Player acquisition. Sun avoidance is native navigation behavior, not petrification, forced burning or a custom daylight defense. ROCK_FLAG syncs false initially; rockCooldown starts300..399 and block state initially null. setHasRock server adds/removes transient follow-range+8 by fixed ID (default16->24), then swaps goal: rock=true RangedAttackGoal(speed1,min20,max60,range15), false MeleeAttackGoal(speed1.2,longMemoryfalse). Does not add armor, HP, attack damage or knockback immunity. Ordinary ranged goal distance/LOS/timer controls remain, callbacks not fixed60 ticks regardless distance.

Server Troll.tick after super: only !hasRock && target!=null; positive cooldown decrements, else makes one random sample floor(x-2+rand*4),floor(y+rand*3),floor(z-2+rand*4). Outline/no-fluid ray from (blockX+.5,sampledY+.5,blockZ+.5) to sampled center must report the sampled blockPos, and sampled state must be BASE_STONE_OVERWORLD. Native raw tag: stone/granite/diorite/andesite/deepslate/tuff. If accepted, stores state then level.removeBlock(pos,false), ignores result, emits BLOCK_DESTROY. There is no canEntityGrief, EntityUtil.canDestroyBlock, hardness, inventory or drop-return gate in this TF method; ordinary world set/remove behavior still applies. If field rock!=null, setHasRock(true), create owned ThrownBlock with that state, startRiding Troll and addFreshEntity. Failed initial sample retries while cooldown0; cooldown only counts down while target present and no held rock. Rock carrying creates a real projectile entity, not just a render flag.

performRangedAttack requires hasRock, creates a NEW ThrownBlock(level,Troll,rock), aims target X/Z and minY+height/3 with+.2*horizontalDistance elevation, speed1.6/inaccuracy4-difficultyId. Native constructor spawns at owner eyeY-.1 and sets projectile owner Troll. Adds it, setHasRock(false), discards FIRST passenger only if its type is TF THROWN_BLOCK, resets cooldown300..399, clears rock=null. Throw does not directly hurt and does not release/reuse the carried entity. Passenger attachment height1.25*Troll height and rotation tracking are cosmetic geometry, but carried projectile is ticked by native Entity.rideTick (zero velocity then projectile tick, unless244 pre-tick event cancels), and has no isPassenger guard in impact callback. Thus native carried contact is a separate eligible delivery if the ordinary collision engine actually admits contact; no guaranteed hit count or fabricated launch. Missing/discarded passenger does not itself clear Troll ROCK_FLAG; flags/state drive the later throw.

Troll saves HasRock, RockCooldown and RockState only if nonnull; read always invokes NbtUtils.readBlockState on getCompound(RockState). Native missing Name produces AIR.defaultBlockState, which is nonnull. Therefore ordinary save/load of no-rock Troll can leave rock=Air with hasRock=false; at cooldown0 and target present, a failed stone sample still reaches rock!=null and creates a carried Air-state projectile. Valid later sample can overwrite it; ThrownBlock damage6 does not depend on state. Read restores follow-range/task from HasRock; native passenger save/load is separate, not reconstructed by this method. Death calls super.tickDeath then every deathTime%5==0 scans inclusive+/-12 cube (15625 positions), replaces exact UNRIPE_TROLLBER with ripe on independent nextBoolean and abs(x+y+z)%5==deathTime/5. Ordinary20-tick death visits offsets1..4; residue0 is not visited, no single guaranteed full ripening. No own server/grief/hurt-success gate, HP heal, explosion or summoned attack in these helpers; terrain/food availability is documented as an exclusion from unique combat packages. WorldUtil range proof reused. No extra Troll death boss phase.

effects.display_name: Maze Slime size and threefold native health
effects.primary_test_source: Native naturally finalized MazeSlime or native split child
alternate_sources: Native egg/admin command initialization; ordinary reload preserving damaged health; split cancellation
actual_behavior: MazeSlime extends native Slime and is registered with Monster.createMonsterAttributes, dimensions.52x.52/eye.325 before size scaling. Native Slime.setSize clamps n to1..127, sets size/dimensions, base MAX_HEALTH=n*n, speed=.2+.1*n, attack=n; ordinary max-health attribute caps at1024. TF override then addOrReplacePermanentModifier id twilightforest:double_health, amount2, ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE, and ALWAYS setHealth(getMaxHealth()), even resetHealth=false; xpReward uses requested size+3. With ordinary unmodified attributes, effective maximum is min(3*n*n,1024), NOT2*n*n. Natural finalized sizes1/2/4 therefore HP3/12/48, attack1/2/4 and speed.3/.4/.6. This is native HP assignment at size change, not regeneration or a separate DamageSource. Same modifier ID replaces rather than stacking on repeated setSize. External attributes/effects can change final values; no balancing change introduced.

Registered Maze placement is nonPeaceful && checkMobSpawnRules && Monster.isDarkEnoughToSpawn, not vanilla slime-chunk/moon/Y spawning. Inherited finalize chooses i=nextInt3; if i<2 and randomFloat<.5*specialDifficultyMultiplier increment; setSize(1<<i,true) then super finalization. Actual initialized size/HP must be observed, not constructor defaults or an unfinalized test entity. Native NBT stores Size=n-1 and wasOnGround plus normal Living health/attributes. Exact244 Slime.readAdditionalSaveData calls virtual setSize(storedSize+1,false) BEFORE superclass loading; TF temporarily fills health there, then native Living load restores saved Health and attributes. Thus this override alone does NOT prove free healing on ordinary reload. Persistent modifier ID survives native attribute serialization without intentional stacking. Native command with explicit NBT can skip randomization, while ordinary command without NBT finalizes; those are different initial states, not production fixes.

Native Slime.remove: server && size>1 && isDeadOrDying -> choose2+nextInt3 children, size integer parent/2, create via actual entity type (MazeSlime). Copies name, NoAI, invulnerable and persistence-required flag, calls child.setSize(j,true), positions offsets from parent dimensions; no inherited low HP, owner or shared health pool. TF override yields fresh child HP3*j*j (native max clamp applies). Exact244 posts MobSplitEvent after preparing children; only notCanceled adds them, then parent removal proceeds regardless. No split for size1, living unload/removal, client side or missing child creation; no native finalizeSpawn call for children and no independent TF summon code. Removal reason alone is not the test: dead/dying state matters. Size4 native child sizes2 then1 can still deal contact damage. This inherited split is a delivery of the size/contact packages, not a newly invented custom summon type.

paths.native_delivery: NagaSegment.hurt forwards the SAME DamageSource and amount*2F/3F to parent.hurt when !isInvisible; returns parent result. It neither calls own super.hurt nor subtracts local HP. Multiplication/division occur before parent invulnerability, incoming event, armor, Resistance/protection, absorption and shared hurt cooldown. This is a fixed segment-hit reduction, not a head damage cap or projectile immunity. Two-thirds applies to bypass-tagged sources too; parent source-specific rejection remains. Source direct/causing entities are unchanged and checked against home bounds at the head. Generic Entity queries/AoEs can include head plus multiple parts and make separate forwarded requests; LivingEntity-only AoEs exclude the parts. No Naga-wide attack-ID deduplication exists. Native piercing-arrow ignored IDs are per hit entity, so head/parts are separate candidates, bounded by piercing and collision/return handling. Forwarded requests share head invulnerableTime/lastHurt: equal/lower during>10 is rejected unless BYPASSES_COOLDOWN, larger admitted request contributes only excess over prior amount. A later head hit can therefore add the difference after a reduced segment hit; do not multiply full damage by13. A successful ordinary nonpiercing arrow discards. paths.native_delivery: HedgeSpider uses native Spider HP16/speed.3/baseattack2. These melee paths use native minecraft:mob_attack, direct=causing actual attacking mob, effective ATTACK_DAMAGE plus ordinary native enchantment processing; no custom DamageSource or armor/shield/Resistance/protection/cooldown bypass. Native causingLiving difficulty scaling applies to Player victims. Native hurt true is admission, not a measured HP loss. Hunger is a vanilla MobEffect/resource operation, not another damage event; any later starvation is separate ownerless minecraft:starve, not attributed to the mosquito. Static source evidence only; no runtime, L2, SHP, Stage or production claim.

paths.native_delivery: MazeSlime extends native Slime and is registered with Monster.createMonsterAttributes, dimensions.52x.52/eye.325 before size scaling. Native Slime.setSize clamps n to1..127, sets size/dimensions, base MAX_HEALTH=n*n, speed=.2+.1*n, attack=n; ordinary max-health attribute caps at1024. TF override then addOrReplacePermanentModifier id twilightforest:double_health, amount2, ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE, and ALWAYS setHealth(getMaxHealth()), even resetHealth=false; xpReward uses requested size+3. With ordinary unmodified attributes, effective maximum is min(3*n*n,1024), NOT2*n*n. Natural finalized sizes1/2/4 therefore HP3/12/48, attack1/2/4 and speed.3/.4/.6. This is native HP assignment at size change, not regeneration or a separate DamageSource. Same modifier ID replaces rather than stacking on repeated setSize. External attributes/effects can change final values; no balancing change introduced. Registered Maze placement is nonPeaceful && checkMobSpawnRules && Monster.isDarkEnoughToSpawn, not vanilla slime-chunk/moon/Y spawning. Inherited finalize chooses i=nextInt3; if i<2 and randomFloat<.5*specialDifficultyMultiplier increment; setSize(1<<i,true) then super finalization. Actual initialized size/HP must be observed, not constructor defaults or an unfinalized test entity. Native NBT stores Size=n-1 and wasOnGround plus normal Living health/attributes. Exact244 Slime.readAdditionalSaveData calls virtual setSize(storedSize+1,false) BEFORE superclass loading; TF temporarily fills health there, then native Living load restores saved Health and attributes. Thus this override alone does NOT prove free healing on ordinary reload. Persistent modifier ID survives native attribute serialization without intentional stacking. Native command with explicit NBT can skip randomization, while ordinary command without NBT finalizes; those are different initial states, not production fixes.
